scripts.skills:spec: for skill in skills/*/; do uvx --from skills-ref==0.1.1 agentskills validate "$skill" || exit 1; done
scripts.skills:scan: uvx --from cisco-ai-skill-scanner==2.2.0 skill-scanner scan-all skills --fail-on-severity high
scripts.test:eval: uv run python -B -m unittest discover -s eval/harness -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run standard:check && bun run skills:check && bun run skills:lint && bun run skills:spec && bun run test && bun run test:python && bun run test:eval
